dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| where isnotempty(['sha256'])
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| extend Community = tostring(['community'])
| extend RuleName = tostring(['rule_name'])
| extend MalwareFamily = tostring(['malware_family'])
| extend InstanceId = tostring(['instance_id'])
| extend TagsRaw = tostring(['tags'])
| extend PolyScoreRaw = todouble(['polyscore'])
| extend Sha256Lower = tolower(tostring(['sha256']))
| extend DigestType = 'SHA-256'
| extend DigestValue = tolower(tostring(['sha256']))
| extend ObservableKey = strcat("file:hashes.'", DigestType, "'")
| where DigestValue !contains "'" and DigestValue !contains @"\"
| extend EscapedValue = DigestValue
| extend ObservableValue = DigestValue
| extend Pattern = strcat("[", ObservableKey, " = '", EscapedValue, "']")
| extend Permalink = iff(isempty(Sha256Lower), '', strcat('https://polyswarm.network/scan/results/file/', Sha256Lower, '/', InstanceId))
| extend Confidence = iff(isnotnull(PolyScoreRaw), toint(round(PolyScoreRaw * 100, 0)), int(null))
| extend ValidFrom = now()
| extend ValidUntil = datetime_add('day', 90, now())
| extend Created = now()
| extend Modified = now()
| extend IsActive = true
| extend IsDeleted = false
| extend Revoked = false
| extend SourceSystem = 'PolySwarm'
| extend LastUpdateMethod = 'PolySwarm hunting'
| extend FamilyLabel = iff(isempty(MalwareFamily), 'unclassified', MalwareFamily)
| extend Description = iff(isempty(RuleName), 'PolySwarm hunt result', strcat('PolySwarm hunt rule: ', RuleName))
| extend idSeed = strcat(DigestType, '|', DigestValue, '|', Community, '|', RuleName)
| extend idHex = substring(tostring(hash_sha256(idSeed)), 0, 32)
| extend Id = strcat('indicator--', substring(idHex,0,8), '-', substring(idHex,8,4), '-', substring(idHex,12,4), '-', substring(idHex,16,4), '-', substring(idHex,20,12))
| extend AdditionalFields = pack('polyscore', PolyScoreRaw, 'family', FamilyLabel, 'rule_name', RuleName, 'community', Community, 'permalink', Permalink, 'tags', TagsRaw, 'detections', ['detections'], 'digest_type', DigestType, 'stixIdHex', idHex)
| extend Data = pack('type', 'indicator', 'spec_version', '2.1', 'id', Id, 'created', Created, 'modified', Modified, 'name', Description, 'description', Description, 'indicator_types', pack_array('malicious-activity'), 'pattern', Pattern, 'pattern_type', 'stix', 'valid_from', ValidFrom, 'valid_until', ValidUntil, 'confidence', Confidence, 'labels', pack_array(FamilyLabel))
| project TimeGenerated, Id, ObservableKey, ObservableValue, Pattern, SourceSystem, Confidence, IsActive, IsDeleted, Revoked, ValidFrom, ValidUntil, Created, Modified, LastUpdateMethod, AdditionalFields, Data
